definition: The Rankine cycle is a vapor power cycle in which a working fluid is pumped, heated, expanded to produce work and condensed for reuse.
entry_text: The Rankine cycle is a vapor power cycle in which a working fluid is pumped, heated, expanded to produce work and condensed for reuse.
example: An engineer uses the cycle to model a steam power plant's conversion of heat into shaft work.
label: Rankine cycle
